Fitted black button shirt with sleeves rolled to forearms, black belt and straight black trousers, polished black shoes. Upright reserved bearing. Six head-and-shoulder views in a three-column two-row grid: front, left three-quarter, right three-quarter, left profile, right profile, back. Premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D romance-game character rendering, finely modeled face, soft matte skin microtexture, detailed hair strands and fabric, broad soft frontal illumination, pure white studio background, no additional people, logos or watermark.
original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / character production reference. Evan Miller. Input Image 1 is the user-approved facial master and SOLE identity/skin/hair/rendering reference.
ONE landscape six-angle head-and-shoulders contact sheet, EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, each view same scale, entire hair and shoulders in each cell. Top row left-to-right: front-left three-quarter (-45 degree yaw), strict front (0), front-right three-quarter (+45). Bottom row: true left profile (-90), true right profile (+90), rear-right three-quarter (135). Rotate same head about vertical axis with level chin, horizontal eye line, no upward/downward pitch and no tilt. All six show a calm neutral expression. Distinct angles, not six similar fronts. Identity and hair precisely locked to Image 1.
Identity and approved costume: Adult man, ash blonde swept side-part short hair, gray-green eyes, angular refined longish face, subtle lips, clean shaven. Same black open-collar long sleeve shirt tucked into black pleated trousers, black loafers. Approved natural tall body proportions, do not elongate or compress.
Style: preserve the original premium Vicky otome semi-realistic 2.5D/3D finish, modeled facial planes, precise realistic eye shapes, natural skin detail and fine individual hair strands, rich but soft studio lighting. Do not beautify into a generic face or switch to cel anime, photograph, sketch or low-detail plastic.
Clean seamless pure white background. Landscape 1536x1024 composition with evenly aligned views, no cut-off hair/feet, no extra panels, no titles or logos, no decorative frames, no accessories/props not in source. Small unobtrusive English view/emotion labels below each view are allowed only; do not put text over the character. Keep the person's exact eye spacing, nose, mouth, jaw, age, complexion and identifying marks.
